description: This file contains a script for managing GitHub discussions and comments related to translation pull requests in the FastAPI project. It interacts with GitHub's GraphQL API, handles discussion and comment retrieval, creation, and updates, and processes pull request labels to determine notification actions.

classes.name: Comment
classes.description: Represents a GitHub discussion comment with id, url, and body.

classes.name: UpdateDiscussionComment
classes.description: Wraps a Comment object for updating a discussion comment.

classes.name: UpdateCommentData
classes.description: Contains the updateDiscussionComment field for response validation.

classes.name: UpdateCommentResponse
classes.description: Response model for updating a comment.

classes.name: AddDiscussionComment
classes.description: Wraps a Comment object for adding a discussion comment.

classes.name: AddCommentData
classes.description: Contains the addDiscussionComment field for response validation.

classes.name: AddCommentResponse
classes.description: Response model for adding a discussion comment.

classes.name: CommentsEdge
classes.description: Represents an edge in the comments connection, with a node (Comment) and cursor.

classes.name: Comments
classes.description: Contains a list of comment edges.

classes.name: CommentsDiscussion
classes.description: Contains comments for a discussion.

classes.name: CommentsRepository
classes.description: Contains discussion comments within a repository.

classes.name: CommentsData
classes.description: Contains repository data for comments.

classes.name: CommentsResponse
classes.description: Top-level response model for comments data.

classes.name: AllDiscussionsLabelNode
classes.description: Represents a label node in discussions.

classes.name: AllDiscussionsLabelsEdge
classes.description: Edge connecting to a label node.

classes.name: AllDiscussionsDiscussionLabels
classes.description: Labels associated with a discussion.

classes.name: AllDiscussionsDiscussionNode
classes.description: Represents a discussion node with labels.

classes.name: AllDiscussionsDiscussions
classes.description: Contains list of discussion nodes.

classes.name: AllDiscussionsRepository
classes.description: Repository containing discussions.

classes.name: AllDiscussionsData
classes.description: Top-level data containing repository discussions.

classes.name: AllDiscussionsResponse
classes.description: Response model for discussions data.

classes.name: Settings
classes.description: Configuration settings for the script, including GitHub repository info, token, and environment variables.

classes.name: PartialGitHubEventIssue
classes.description: Partial model for GitHub pull request event data.

classes.name: PartialGitHubEvent
classes.description: Partial model for GitHub event data, including pull request info.

methods.name: get_graphql_response
methods.description: Sends a GraphQL request to GitHub API with specified query and variables, returns the JSON response.

methods.name: get_graphql_translation_discussions
methods.description: Retrieves discussions related to translations from GitHub.

methods.name: get_graphql_translation_discussion_comments_edges
methods.description: Fetches comment edges for a specific discussion.

methods.name: get_graphql_translation_discussion_comments
methods.description: Retrieves all comments for a specific discussion, handling pagination.

methods.name: create_comment
methods.description: Creates a new comment in a discussion.

methods.name: update_comment
methods.description: Updates an existing comment in a discussion.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main execution function that manages the process of notifying or marking translation PR discussions based on PR labels and state.
